D1.statement: Anything new ChanServ shows with a date and time uses RFC 3339 in UTC (`2026-11-17T09:30:00Z`); the notes list keeps `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC`.

D2.statement: Every use of a staff-only command sends `STAFF <account> <COMMAND> <#channel>` on the channels server-notice mask.

D3.statement: Whatever tells a founder about an action by staff names them only as `network staff`.

D4.statement: Every mail: subject starts `[<network name>]`, plain text, last line `-- <network name> staff`.

D5.statement: Expiry defaults: 60 days and a 7-day warning (T6 prompt), then 90 and 14 (said after T8, whether or not it passed: 'whoever next works on expiry should make those the defaults').

P1.statement: Unsolicited ChanServ messages are NOTICEs starting `[#Channel] `.
P1.pattern: \b(?:unsolicited|own[- ]initiative|on its own (?:initiative|accord)|unprompted|unrequested|(?:nobody|no one) asked(?: for)?|without being (?:asked|prompted)|uninvited|house style|not (?:in|as) (?:an? )?(?:answer|reply|response) to a command)\b[^.\n]{0,240}(?:square brackets|bracketed|\[#\w+\]|\[<[^>\]]*channel[^>\]]*>\])|(?:square brackets|bracketed|\[#\w+\]|\[<[^>\]]*channel[^>\]]*>\])[^.\n]{0,240}\b(?:unsolicited|own[- ]initiative|on its own (?:initiative|accord)|unprompted|unrequested|(?:nobody|no one) asked(?: for)?|without being (?:asked|prompted)|uninvited|house style|not (?:in|as) (?:an? )?(?:answer|reply|response) to a command)\b

D8.statement: The server cuts every line it sends at 512 bytes, with no error: long text a user typed (greeting, reason, note, history entry) must go out as several NOTICEs. A record counts when it says the cutting (of lines the server sends), or that long text must be split into several NOTICEs because of it; a record that only says a greeting is split to fit the limit does not.

D12.statement: ChanServ splits a command's text on spaces, so runs of spaces collapse; a service command that takes free text as its last parameter must ask for it whole (`maxParams` with `unsplitFinalParam: true` in its entry of chanservCommands) to get the text as typed.

D13.statement: ergo keeps account names case-folded for comparing (client.Account(), channel.Founder()); the name as it was registered is client.AccountName() or LoadAccount(name).Name, and that is what is shown to people.
